main.description: Takes out every member, withdraws every invitation, deletes the organization's space and its dev.knotless.org record. The account and its repositories stay. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview acts with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session call the organization's gateway themselves.

errors.description: The change was refused: by the organization's gateway, or as the account may not make it.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

warning.description: Set when the change was made only in part, saying what is left.

description: Ends the organization the account logged in to this appview's pages is, as `knotless org delete` does.
